categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of semiconductor silicon materials. Its main product lines include semiconductor silicon polished wafers (6-8 inch), silicon materials for etching equipment (11-21 inch), semiconductor zone-melted silicon single crystals, and semiconductor clean valves and fittings. These products serve integrated circuits, discrete devices, power devices, sensors, optical devices, and etching equipment components, widely applied in automotive electronics, industrial electronics, and aerospace sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced crystal growth technologies such as the Czochralski method for single crystal silicon growth, zone melting for high-purity silicon single crystals, and precision silicon wafer processing including slicing, grinding, polishing, cleaning, and testing. It has proprietary technologies in thermal field design, doping and defect control, large-diameter crystal growth, heat treatment, thin film growth, and contamination control. The company also emphasizes digital manufacturing execution systems (MES), statistical process control (SPC), and SAP-based management for quality and efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include downstream chip manufacturers and etching equipment component manufacturers. The end markets served encompass integrated circuits, discrete devices, power devices, sensors, and high-end microelectronic devices. Major application industries are consumer electronics, AI, electric vehicles, industrial electronics, aerospace, photovoltaic, and optical communications. The company’s products are sold domestically and internationally, with a significant portion of sales in China and other countries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with headquarters in Beijing and major production facilities in Shandong Province (Dezhou). It serves both domestic and international markets, with export sales to various countries. The company is expanding capacity and product lines to meet global semiconductor industry demands.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the upstream to midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain, focusing on the production of semiconductor-grade silicon materials and components used in chip manufacturing and etching equipment. It supplies critical raw and intermediate materials to downstream semiconductor device manufacturers and equipment producers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include focusing on integrated circuit silicon materials, enhancing technology and competitiveness, and expanding product lines and services in the semiconductor industry chain. The company emphasizes innovation-driven development, continuous R&D investment, and technology cost reduction. Key R&D projects target 8-inch silicon wafer expansion, etching equipment silicon materials, and large-diameter zone-melted silicon crystals. The company also pursues domestic substitution of key materials and equipment to improve supply chain security.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of semiconductor silicon polished wafers, etching equipment silicon materials, zone-melted silicon single crystals, and clean valves and fittings. The company mainly uses a direct sales model, supplemented by limited agency and distribution channels. Sales prices are market-driven and adjusted based on supply-demand dynamics and customer customization.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic semiconductor silicon material manufacturer in China, recognized as a national high-tech enterprise with multiple national technology centers and innovation platforms. It competes with global leaders such as Shin-Etsu, SUMCO, and GlobalWafers, and is advancing to close the gap through technology innovation and capacity expansion. The company holds a strong position in 6-inch and 8-inch silicon wafers and etching equipment materials, with growing presence in 12-inch wafer projects.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 995.9 million, a 3.7% increase year-over-year, with a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 232.9 million, a slight decline of 8.37%. Total assets reached RMB 5.37 billion, up 6.44% from the prior year. The company maintains steady growth with ongoing investments in capacity expansion and R&D, including major projects with budgets exceeding RMB 1.8 billion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, stable semiconductor silicon materials with advanced proprietary technologies ensuring low defect density, high purity, and precise electrical properties. It offers differentiated products such as large-diameter zone-melted silicon single crystals and high-value-added etching equipment materials. The company’s focus on domestic substitution enhances supply chain security and cost competitiveness. Strong customer relationships and rapid market responsiveness further differentiate its offerings.
